Summary: Embedded Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in low-level software, Embedded Linux, firmware development, hardware-software integration, and hardware security. Experienced in Linux kernel driver development, Device Tree, bootloader mechanisms, secure firmware, and system-level software for custom SoCs and embedded platforms. Hands-on experience across aerospace, defense, and autonomous systems, including hardware-implemented security mechanisms, UAV flight software, companion computers, camera and sensor integration, and hardware bring-up and validation.
